options.name: access_type
options.description: Specifies whether the snapshot directory or protocol access is granted to the filesystem snapshot. For create operation, if I(access_type) is not specified, snapshot will be created with C(SNAPSHOT) access type.

options.name: array_ip
options.description: IP or FQDN of the PowerStore management system.

options.name: description
options.description: The description for the filesystem snapshot.

options.name: desired_retention
options.description: The retention value for the Snapshot. If the I(desired_retention)/I(expiration_timestamp) is not mentioned during creation, snapshot will be created with unlimited retention. Maximum supported desired retention is 31 days.

options.name: expiration_timestamp
options.description: The expiration timestamp of the snapshot. This should be provided in UTC format, e.g 2020-07-24T10:54:54Z. To remove the expiration timestamp, specify it as an empty string.

options.name: filesystem
options.description: The ID/Name of the filesystem for which snapshot will be taken. If filesystem name is specified, then I(nas_server) is required to uniquely identify the filesystem. Mandatory for create operation.

options.name: is_secure
options.description: Indicates whether the snapshot is a secure snapshot. Secure snapshots cannot be deleted or have their retention reduced until the retention period expires. When set to C(true) during creation, I(expiration_timestamp) must be provided. Can also be set to C(true) on an existing snapshot to mark it as secure (one-way lock). This operation cannot be reverted.

options.name: nas_server
options.description: The NAS server, this could be the name or ID of the NAS server.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the PowerStore host.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number for the PowerStore array. If not passed, it will take 443 as default.

options.name: snapshot_name
options.description: The name of the filesystem snapshot. Mandatory for create operation. Specify either snapshot name or ID (but not both) for any operation.

options.name: state
options.description: Defines whether the filesystem snapshot should exist or not.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which the connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: user
options.description: The username of the PowerStore host.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. Set the environment variable REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE to the path of the SSL certificate. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
